title: Billed Part of the Closing Month — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Proration Schedule
content:
The platform fee of the month in which a Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service closes is billed for a part of that month: the billed part of the closing month is a multiplier counted in thirds of the month from an anchor that depends on when the service was activated.

**Schedule clause.**
(a) For a service activated during the closing month the part is counted from its activation date: a closure no more than 10 calendar days after the activation date, counting the closing date but not the activation date, has a billed-part multiplier of one third, a closure no more than 20 days after it has a multiplier of two thirds, and a later closure has a multiplier of one.
(b) For a service activated in an earlier month whose closure falls on or before day 20 of the closing month the part is counted from the first day of the month: a closure on day 10 or earlier has a billed-part multiplier of one third, and a later closure up to day 20 has a multiplier of two thirds.
(c) Any other closure has a billed-part multiplier of one.

The activation date is the date on the service record on which business verification and the first deposit activated the service; the closing date is the day the closure is taken.

## Schedule (a) — activated in the closing month

| Calendar days from the activation date to the closing date | Billed part |
|---|---|
| 10 or fewer | one third |
| 11 to 20 | two thirds |
| 21 or more | one |

## Schedule (b) and (c) — activated in an earlier month

| Day of the closing month on which the closure falls | Billed part |
|---|---|
| day 1 to day 10 | one third |
| day 11 to day 20 | two thirds |
| day 21 or later | one |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical days)

- Activated on the 4th of the closing month, closing on the 14th: 10 days, one third. Closing on the 15th: 11 days, two thirds. Closing on the 24th: 20 days, two thirds. Closing on the 25th: 21 days, one.
- Activated in an earlier month, closing on the 10th: one third; on the 11th: two thirds; on the 20th: two thirds; on the 21st: one.
